name: Kenjutsu Shoujo Izumi Rei to Mujintou ~Ouchi no Okite da... Omae to Kozukuri ni Hagende Yaru~
original_name: 剣術少女和泉令と無人島～お家の掟だ…お前と子作りに励んでやる～
source:
The protagonist is a school pupil, and the successor to the Yashima school of martial arts.

This year, he' is determined on getting a girlfriend to enjoy summer with!

But just as he has made up his mind, his father sends him to a remote uninhabited island to duel against a student of a rival martial arts school.
On the island, he meets Izumi Rei, a cool and beautiful girl. They duel, and Satoshi narrowly emerges victoriously.
The girl then tells him that since she lost, by the rules of her house, she must accept Satoshi's children.


[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE038505.html]English DLSite[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名小学生，也是八岛武道的传人。

今年，他决心找个女朋友一起过夏天！

但正当他下定决心时，父亲却把他送到一个偏远的无人岛上，与对手武术学校的学生决斗。
在岛上，他遇到了清凉美丽的女孩泉丽。他们决斗，中本聪险胜。
女孩然后告诉他，既然她输了，根据家里的规则，她必须接受中本聪的孩子们。
